instructions_to_main_agent: You are working on a pure JavaScript (.js) project, do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Implement glassmorphism cards using Tailwind exactly like this: 'bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/[0.08] backdrop-blur-[12px] rounded-xl'.
All interactive elements MUST have 'data-testid' (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
The layout should consist of a fixed Sidebar and a scrollable main content area. Sidebar should use the 'surface' background color (bg-white/[0.04]) and border-r border-white/[0.08].
Ensure 'Inter' font is NOT used for headings. Import and use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text via Google Fonts in index.css.
The accent color is strictly #FF3B30. Primary buttons MUST have a soft red glow: 'shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,59,48,0.3)]'.
For the Audit Logs, use a monospace font like JetBrains Mono for IPs, IDs, or timestamps to make it feel highly technical.
Dashboard layout must follow the 'Control Room' grid archetype - tight gaps (gap-6) and utilizing the full horizontal space.
